tests.reason: Everything else in this change writes or reads a member's own data on the shared production database (the switches, the usage-data delete, the rollup's routines and insight, the ORB tool's read of a member's timeline), so staging probes only the anonymous GETs. The suite proves: the rollup's four routine kinds and thresholds, the learning switches (app_usage off, category off, hidden rows), one insight per day without repeats, the profiler's query filter + pre-migration fallback + week movers, get_my_timeline's facts and its last-resort catalog tier, and the routes' auth, validation, JWT scoping, 409 before the migration and usage-data delete incl. the archive. The SQL test (SQL-COMPANION-WIRING) proves the migration on a throwaway Postgres.
